description: Profile of an eSoccer (virtual football, EA FC) player: ELO and league ranking, win rate, draws, goals scored and conceded per match, goals per match vs the league, matches with 3, 4 or 5+ goals, current run of 3+ goal matches (or 2 or fewer), form, latest matches with clubs, frequent opponents, next match. For "how is X playing", "X stats", "is X in form", "how many goals does X score", "who does X play most", "when does X play next". Window as on Bettrails: last 6 months if at least 15 matches, else whole career. May include a free sample of member data (active streaks). Statistics only: no odds, no betting advice.

language.description: Language of the returned bettrails.com links (usually the conversation language). Default: es.

league.description: If omitted, the league where the player has played most. Key = league name in lowercase, without spaces or a final "League(s)"; ggleague = GG League; volta = EsportsBattle Volta.

name: esoccer_player
title: eSoccer player profile
